jobs.title: Director, Data Science
jobs.description:
161 Bay Street (93021), Canada, Toronto,Toronto, Ontario,Director, Data Science

About Capital One Canada

For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated.

We’re driven by what’s possible, leveraging the power of data and technology to empower innovative solutions, inspire one another to dream boldly, and take transformative ownership of decisions and outcomes that directly impact millions of Canadians. Every challenge is an opportunity to lead from the front, working together toward a shared vision that extends far beyond banking.

We balance high-performance with investment in your long-term success, ensuring you have the support you need to do your best work. Here, you’ll take full accountability for your path, upskilling through hands-on experience and mentorship, to turn your curiosity into a career built on your own terms.

Are you ready to redefine what’s next?

About The Team

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

We're building a portfolio of agentic AI products to transform Capital One's engineering organizations and lines of business – autonomous coding agents, context engineering, and agentic model-development lifecycle to name a few. We're creating a new science team to help define the long-term strategy, analyze & optimize impact throughout the ecosystem, and drive business value at enterprise scale. As a scientist on the team, you'd design AI/ML models and help build the solutions behind these products. You'd also own the science that guides them: designing experiments (A/B tests), modeling telemetry, and turning the results into AI strategy and guidance for C-suite leadership.

About The Role

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in AI and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, AI & ML engineers, and product managers to deliver enterprise products customers love
Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The ideal candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.
Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond.
Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.
A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date :
A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 9 years of experience performing data analytics
A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 7 years of experience performing data analytics
A PHD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 4 years of experience performing data analytics

At least 4 years of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysis
At least 4 years of experience building/deploying AI/ML models in production
At least 4 years of experience designing and analyzing A/B tests

Preferred Qualifications:

PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 5 years of experience in data analytics
3+ years of experience working with AWS
5+ years of experience in Python, Scala, or R for large scale data analysis
5+ years of experience with machine learning
5+ years of experience with Spark

Working at Capital One

You’ll be empowered to take end-to-end ownership of your work and your career, backed by a high-performance, hybrid culture and holistic suite of benefits designed to support your whole self.

Take ownership of your own potential: Whether you’re looking to upskill, pivot into new business areas, or master your craft, you’ll have access to tools and mentorship to reach your potential and define your career trajectory.
Find your rhythm: We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.
Benefits built for your life: We take a holistic approach to well-being, providing support for you and those who are most important to you. This includes: full coverage for spouses, domestic partners and dependents, a one-time Work From Home allowance to build your comfortable workspace, up to $3,000 in mental health coverage and up to $5,000 in annual tuition subsidies.

You’ll find that Capital One is committed to helping you thrive and evolve every step of the way.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

This role is eligible to earn performance-based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es). Incentives could be discretionary or non-discretionary depending on the plan.

jobs.description:
Director of Finance & Operations

Rubin & Co. LLP
(the firm) is seeking a highly organized, analytical, and collaborative Director of Finance & Operations
to join our growing team. This is a hands-on role, responsible for overseeing the firm’s financial operations, business processes, marketing initiatives, and special projects. Reporting to the Managing Director, the Director of Finance & Operations will work closely with firm leadership to ensure the effective management of the firm’s financial and operational functions, while supporting strategic initiatives and opportunities to improve efficiency, reporting, and business performance.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Management & Administration

Oversee the firm’s day-to-day financial operations, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll, and cash management.
Manage the client accounting and billing functions, including client intake, time and billing systems, invoice preparation, billing adjustments and reconciliation, payment tracking, and collections.
Oversee the processing of vendor invoices and cheque requests, including authorizations, general ledger and tax coding, and compliance with firm policies and applicable Law Society of Ontario requirements.
Perform and oversee bank, trust, vendor, and general ledger reconciliations and ensure discrepancies are identified and resolved promptly.
Support monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial processes, including preparation of accurate financial reports and information for leadership and external advisors.
Prepare, monitor, and report on lawyer productivity, billing, and other key financial and operational metrics.
Review and process employee expense reports in accordance with firm policies.
Oversee office-related expenses and ensure appropriate general ledger categorization and financial organization.
Respond to accounting and financial inquiries in a timely, professional, and solutions-oriented manner.
Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, systems, and procedures to increase efficiency and accuracy.

Business Operations & Special Projects

Work closely with the Managing Director and firm leadership on business planning, operational priorities, and strategic initiatives.
Develop, maintain, and report on key financial and operational performance metrics, including reviewing and improving operational processes, systems, and workflows firm-wide.
Prepare financial and operational information and analyses to support leadership decision-making.
Support the implementation and optimization of technology, systems, and business processes.
Coordinate and manage special projects and strategic initiatives as required.
Assist with vendor management, contracts, office administration, and other business operations.
Identify opportunities to improve the firm’s overall efficiency, client experience, and internal processes.
Take ownership of projects from planning through execution, ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met.

Marketing & Communications

Support and oversee the execution of the firm’s marketing and communications strategy in collaboration with the Managing Director and external marketing resources.
Manage and coordinate the firm’s marketing initiatives, from development through to distribution, via LinkedIn, email communications, newsletters, website content, and other digital communications.
Manage firm webinars and events, including registration, promotional materials, communications, logistics, and post-event follow-up.
Maintain and coordinate updates to the firm’s website, ensuring content is current, accurate, and aligned with the firm’s brand.
Manage and maintain the firm’s mailing lists and subscription databases, including ongoing compliance with applicable CASL requirements.
Monitor and report on marketing and communications analytics, including email, website, social media, and webinar performance.
Work with internal and external stakeholders to develop and implement marketing projects and initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve the firm’s visibility, communications, and engagement with clients and professional audiences.

Knowledge, Skills, & Experience

5 years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, operations, business administration, or a related role; experience working in a law firm or other professional services environment is required.
Experience managing financial operations, including billing, accounts payable/receivable, reconciliations, cash management, and financial reporting.
Accounting, finance, or business education or designation (CPA, CMA, CGA, accounting/finance diploma or degree) is an asset.
Experience with QuickBooks Online and Clio or similar accounting and practice management systems is an asset.
Experience in marketing, communications, project management, or business development is required.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret financial and operational information and identify trends and opportunities.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with excellent time management and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and a professional, client service-oriented approach.
Ability to work independently, take initiative, and exercise sound judgment.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with a high degree of accountability.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Positive, solutions-oriented attitude and demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a team.

Why Join Rubin & Co. LLP?

Rubin & Co. LLP is a growing workplace investigations and consulting firm committed to providing thoughtful, high-quality services to organizations navigating complex workplace matters. We offer an opportunity to work closely with firm leadership and play a meaningful role in the continued growth and development of the business. If this position and our firm are of interest to you, please send your resume in confidence to careers@rubinandco.ca.

We thank all applicants for their interest in joining our team. However, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. **No agencies please.**
To learn more about Rubin & Co. LLP, visit www.rubinandco.ca.

À propos de & Whitney Canada

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928. Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale.

Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde.

Un employeur de choix

Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal.

Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale.

Pourquoi rejoindre l’équipe des Technologies Numériques de Pratt & Whitney Canada ?

Nous sommes en pleine transformation numérique, redéfinissant notre manière de travailler, optimisant nos opérations et transformant nos produits et services pour améliorer les expériences des employés et des clients.

En tant que membre de notre équipe de Technologie Numérique, vous contribuerez à façonner l’avenir en travaillant avec des outils avancés, en automatisant les processus et en innovant dans toutes les fonctions de l’entreprise.

Notre organisation mondiale est déterminée à cultiver une équipe autonome et compétente afin d’apporter des solutions avancées et des capacités numériques à la pointe de la technologie à nos clients.

Sommaire du poste :

Il s’agit d’un rôle de leadership stratégique à fort impact au sein de nos opérations mondiales complexes et orientées mission dans la fabrication et la maintenance après-vente. Le poste bénéficie d’une haute visibilité et implique des interactions à la fois stratégiques et opérationnelles avec les équipes Digital Technologies (DT) et Business Leadership, y compris les cadres supérieurs.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien?

Diriger le COE (centre d’excellence) du ERP (PGI – Progiciel de Gestion Intégré) mondial, en définissant la vision, le modèle de gouvernance et la structure organisationnelle alignés sur les principes directeurs clés de l’organisation des Technologies Numériques de Pratt & Whitney.
Conseiller les parties prenantes en tant que leader stratégique et technologique, mobiliser l’expertise et les benchmarks industriels, et influencer au sein d’une organisation matricielle complexe.
Stimuler l’innovation et l’amélioration continue, anticiper les tendances technologiques et catalyser le changement pour améliorer l’expérience utilisateur et l’efficacité opérationnelle.
Gérer budgets, capacité et planification financière en collaboration avec les finances sur une base mensuelle.
Communiquer avec l’équipe de direction (SLT) et les cadres pour aligner les priorités.
Gérer les escalades, agir comme point de contact principal pour les problèmes prioritaires et coordonner leur résolution.
Contribuer à la satisfaction des employés, suivre l’engagement et le moral, et collecter les retours via des enquêtes de satisfaction.
Collaborer étroitement avec tous les groupes DT, y compris RTX, pour assurer l’alignement transversal.
Communiquer clairement les problématiques complexes en termes non techniques, tout en guidant l’équipe dans la collecte des besoins, l’analyse des processus et le développement de solutions globales.
Gérer et livrer un portefeuille complexe d’initiatives d’exploitation et de transformation ERP, et maintenir des feuilles de route stratégiques pluriannuelles avec les parties prenantes.
Concevoir et exécuter une stratégie de transformation SAP S/4 HANA spécifique à P&W, alignée avec le programme RTX.
Superviser les opérations quotidiennes du COE : relations fournisseurs, gestion budgétaire et des ressources, suivi de performance et évaluation des risques, en appliquant les méthodologies projet cascade et agile.
Gouverner la gestion du changement ERP, la planification des versions, la gestion de la demande, de la capacité et de la priorisation.
Piloter l’harmonisation des processus globaux et assurer l’alignement avec les objectifs métier pour la planification, fabrication, chaîne d’approvisionnement, qualité, logistique et finance (OEM et Aftermarket).
Maîtriser les ERP et processus métier de bout en bout (Opportunity-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, Plan-to-Sustain) dans un environnement réglementé.
Superviser et optimiser un paysage ERP complexe (SAP et non SAP), incluant PLM, MES, portails fournisseurs, QMS et applications sur mesure.
S’adapter rapidement aux priorités changeantes tout en gérant risque et impacts sur le portefeuille.
Diriger une équipe performante et développer une stratégie de talents : montée en compétences, attraction de nouveaux talents, adoption de SAP S/4 HANA, Analytics et IA générative.
Gérer une équipe mondiale de leaders SAP et experts fonctionnels, promouvoir l’amélioration continue et le partage de connaissances.
Coacher et encadrer les membres de l’équipe pour soutenir leur développement professionnel et renforcer leurs compétences.
Garantir la conformité aux réglementations IT et A&D, aux normes de sécurité (ITAR, DFARS), à la loi SOX et aux contrôles internes.
Soutenir les opérations d’infrastructure pour maintenir les solutions à grande échelle et garantir une couverture 24/7, y compris jours fériés et week-ends.

Ce poste a été désigné comme « sur site
», avec un travail régulier en personne dans nos locaux situés à Longueuil, QC. Il nécessitera également des déplacements vers différents sites selon les besoins pour participer à des sessions de travail et collaborer directement avec différents intervenants de l’entreprise. Les déplacements sont estimés à au moins 25 %. Le poste est basé dans notre site principal à Longueuil, QC.

Quest-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir ?

Qualifications requises :

Baccalauréat en ingénierie, informatique, technologies de l’information ou systèmes d’information avec 14+ années d’expérience dans les systèmes ERP ; OU diplôme supérieur dans les mêmes domaines avec 12+ années d’expérience dans les systèmes ERP.

Qualifications recherchées :

Solide capacité de management – expérience démontrée dans la conduite et la gestion de projets ERP DT complexes et à grande échelle.
Orientation résultats – focalisé sur l’atteinte des objectifs malgré les obstacles internes ou externes.
Aptitude business forte – capacité à apprendre rapidement, comprendre et interpréter les processus métier, agir en tant que partenaire de confiance et être reconnu comme contributeur de valeur.
Compétences interpersonnelles solides – capacité à collaborer efficacement avec différentes équipes pour atteindre des objectifs communs.
Maîtrise des processus de cycle de vie logiciel.
Autonomie et proactivité – capacité à prendre en charge des missions et à livrer des résultats de manière fiable.
Excellentes compétences en communication – aptitude à transmettre clairement des informations complexes, tant à l’écrit qu’à l’oral.

Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une très bonne connaissance de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre, sur une base quotidienne, de la documentation et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.

Ce que nous offrons

Programme de régime de retraite et d’épargne avec cotisation de l’employeur
Programme d’assurance collective
Possibilités d’avancement (progression de carrière)
Programme de mérite ou programme de reconnaissance
Programme de santé et bien-être, y compris la télémédecine
Club récréatif et sportif
Garderies à proximité
Accessibilité en transport ou programme de transport en commun et stationnement gratuit

Travailler chez Pratt & Whitney Canada

Le masculin est utilisé sans discrimination et uniquement dans le but d’alléger le texte. Nous étudierons la demande d’emploi de tous les candidats qualifiés.

Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, nous allions avec passion, audace et rigueur pour concevoir, fabriquer et entretenir les moteurs d’aéronefs les plus avancés et les plus fiables au monde.

Notre travail et la qualité de nos produits contribuent au succès de nos clients, qui à leur tour sauvent des vies, soutiennent le commerce, connectent les communautés et protègent les libertés.
